Software Developer at SOLIDWORKS, Dassault Systèmes.

Passionate about technology and problem-solving; enjoy tennis, sailing, and hands-on projects, always exploring and learning new skills.

📍Boston, MA

data.title: DASSAULT SYSTÈMES
data.subtitle: SOLIDWORKS - Software Development Engineer
description: Redesigned the SolidWorks test framework to improve orchestration speed, and reduce end-to-end test runtime from 18 hours to 13 hours while reliably executing 200,000+ test cases across the codebase.

Developed the Build Slicer system for SolidWorks daily builds, automatically identifying the specific commit causing test failures across multiple global PRs and generating actionable bug reports for the responsible developer, reducing time-to-detect regressions and improving release reliability.

Re-architected the SolidWorks log parsing system from a monolithic Python script into a scalable TypeScript microservice, introducing an extensible object-oriented parser and improving performance by 30%.

Built agentic AI workflows for SolidWorks dev tooling that analyze crash callstacks, map failures to source code, set up reproducible builds, and recommend fixes, significantly reducing time to resolve build and runtime issues.

data.title: DASSAULT SYSTÈMES
data.subtitle: SOLIDWORKS - Software Development Intern
description: Rebuilt a legacy crash analytics tracker as a full-stack web application, leveraging caching and optimized data management to improve responsiveness by 60%, and integrating Elasticsearch for scalable search and visualization.
Introduce automations and optimization to the feedback system DevOps pipeline for SolidWorks desktop. Assisted in the migration of VMs and build machines from CentOS to RHEL.

data.title: INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY BOMBAY
data.subtitle: e-Yantra - Technical Project Researcher
description: Built GradeFast, a Python-based automated grading system that provides instant feedback and eliminates manual grading, reducing instructor grading time by 80% and enabling faster assessment for 300+ students each semester.
Enhanced a Java Spring-based payment gateway, scaling the system to handle peak loads efficiently while automating transaction verification to reduce errors by 20% and improve reliability.
Led development of a RASA/Django FAQ chatbot for the e-Yantra Community App, cutting manual question handling by 30% and boosting user engagement by 20%.

data.title: TOWARDS DEVELOPING A LEARNING ANALYTICS DASHBOARD FOR A MASSIVE ONLINE ROBOTICS COMPETITION
data.subtitle: IEEE Educon
data.description: This research discusses a dashboard developed for a robotics competition where team characteristics are considered for clustering teams and developing models to predict participants' retention and help the competition's instructors monitor their progress and intervene if necessary.

data.title: SPArK-BOT: AN EDUCATIONAL ROBOTIC PLATFORM
data.subtitle: IEEE Educon
data.description: This paper reports the development and explains the features of a highly versatile educational robot focused on teaching beginner-friendly programming and robotics.

data.title: AUTO-QUERY - A SIMPLE NATURAL LANGUAGE TO SQL QUERY GENERATOR
data.subtitle: IEEE Educon
data.description: The study explored ways to develop an application that takes questions in a natural language and converts them into SQL queries using a sequence-to-sequence model for an e-learning platform.
